name: Muha Meds 510 Cartridge | Banana Cream Cake
description: Banana Cream Cake is an indulgent indica with flavors as rich as its name suggests. Creamy banana blends with a smooth, cake-like sweetness, delivering a dessert-worthy experience with every hit. The effects are deeply relaxing and hazy, melting away stress while settling the body into a state of blissful calm. Banana Cream Cake is perfect for winding down at night or when you’re ready to kick back in comfort.
